versions.content: Semantics of meta-class DiagnosticEventToTrouble- CodeJ1939Mapping The DiagnosticEventToTroubleCodeJ1939Mapping is used to assign one (1:1) or multiple (n:1) DiagnosticEvent s to a Diagnostic- TroubleCodeJ1939 . In case of an n:1 mapping, multiple instances of DiagnosticEventToTrouble- CodeJ1939Mapping with the same reference of role troubleCodeJ1939 but dif- ferent references of role diagnosticEvent have to be defined.
